name: felyrics
description: Feline-lyrics, lyrics timing and karaoke video composition.

scripts.predev: npm run build -w @felyrics/toolchain && npm run build -w @felyrics/host
scripts.prebuild: npm run build -w @felyrics/toolchain && npm run build -w @felyrics/host
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @felyrics/toolchain && npm run build -w @felyrics/host
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @felyrics/toolchain && npm run build -w @felyrics/host
scripts.test:python: npm run python -- -m unittest discover -s packages/host/backend/tests -v && npm run python -- -m unittest discover -s services/tests -v
